title: Eclipse Sorceress Ritual
description: A blue-skinned female sorceress with purple hair and horns stands on a stone platform, reading an ancient tome while casting glowing magic. She is surrounded by swirling purple and green energy tendrils, floating hands emerging from clouds, black birds, an incense burner, and a massive red eclipse dominating a ruined gothic cityscape under a dark sky.
prompt: A blue-skinned female sorceress with horns and flowing purple hair stands on a cracked stone altar, wearing ornate dark armor and a long cape, reading an open glowing spellbook. Swirling purple and green magical energy tendrils emanate from her hands and the book. Floating disembodied hands reach upward from clouds, black ravens fly nearby, an incense burner emits smoke. In the background, a massive blood-red eclipse hangs over a ruined gothic city with broken towers reflected in dark water, dramatic cinematic lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere.
